dm.surfacedAsLever: T5-set09: named by Wren as the Circle's one true enemy in the Maw (at open war). A living-Sunn traitor's-gift proof handed to the Lodge = they'd 'drag it into the light and never stop' (matches their agenda: bury or expose a dangerous truth). Unengaged; a potential ally-or-user, double-edged.

dm.traitorHouseRevealedT9: T9-set09: revealed (via the deed) as the FOUNDING TRAITOR-HOUSE — the Iron-Strap gave/signed the Sunns' well to the Ironwood Circle a hundred years ago, then recast themselves as the 'wronged' house wanting a 'lost homeland/status' restored (their agenda). COMPLICATION: Sella herself is tied to the Iron-Strap (her Day-1 criminal origin-tie), so her lever against Corran also detonates her own guild + Maddan (whom she has a knife on). The long-dormant Iron-Strap (2/6) is now central and double-edged — swinging the lever cuts three houses at once (Circle, Iron-Strap, and Sella's own footing).

Strongly implies Batgal is a surviving Sunn / the heir the Strap protects — UNCONFIRMED, deliberately withheld. Ties tonight's Batgal-at-Dessa's thread into the well-war spine.
dm.heirConfirmed: T7: Maddan confirmed OUTRIGHT — Batgal is the last Sunn, the rightful heir to the well. 'Batgal Sukhukh' is a cover bought off a dead refugee's rent-book. Sella already chose to protect him (Dessa's door) before knowing. He is now the MUTUAL HOSTAGE binding Sella and Iron-Strap: if she sells the Strap, the boy pays first, then her. Ties tonight's Batgal-at-Dessa's thread to the throne of the whole well-war.
dm.savedTonight: T10 SLEIGHT OF HAND SUCCESS (beat DC15): Sella passed Iron-Strap a clean dead-drop warning (knotted-wrong net-twine at Ospra's corner) — 'move the boy, the Circle knows the loft, not from me' — under the Circle's alerted watchers without being caught. Batgal will be moved from Dessa's loft in the dark before Corran acts. Sella protected the last Sunn at the cost of her own standing/safety, and he'll never know.
dm.coverTrace: T2-set3: The dead-man rent-book that gives Batgal his cover-name ('checked in, never checked out, book still says he's home') is at a lodging house on SALTWIDOW ROW — the keeper stopped reading his own book years ago, top room let to a dead man since before Susannah arrived. The boy's whole legal existence is written in a dead stranger's hand there. Cover-integrity thread: as long as that book stays unread, the boy stays nobody; if the Circle ever pulls it, the cover unravels.

dm.floodRising: T2-set3: TELEGRAPH of the external front (hard-season/flood). River gauge hit the ten-year mark yesterday and is STILL climbing; three upper-district (dry) houses already have water in their cellars — meaning the evacuation plan (low chains flood, high ground holds) is built on a failing assumption. The uncounted live in rooms built to flood; they drown first. Live, advancing danger to Sella's bolt-hole and the whole quarter.
dm.stillFace: T2-set3 HOOK: a young man across the fire-circle went STILL the instant Sella's questions turned Sunn/Saltwidow-shaped, and stopped looking at her, listening hard. Unidentified — could be a Circle ear, an Iron-Strap watcher, or someone who knows what the Saltwidow book really holds. Unresolved thread.
dm.dawnCount: T6-set3 (engine rest-risk 'threat slipped past the sentry' honored): a Circle enforcer + a clerk with chalk are taking the DAWN FLOOD-COUNT through the warren — striking names off the high-ground/evacuation roll as the flood climbs, deciding who the river is allowed to carry off. Converges internal front (Circle grip) + external front (flood) + the quarter's erasure grievance. NOT hunting Sella specifically, but his counting-line bends toward her row; if he clocks the marked Seam bedded among the uncounted, her dusk-decoy (false bed-location fed to Corran's tail) UNRAVELS and Corran learns where she really hides.
dm.countRead: T6-set3 SUCCESS (Stealth): Sella stayed unseen and READ the Circle counter fully. He strikes by the ROLL (whose name is written safe), not by face — the uncounted get struck because they were already unwritten; it's erasure-by-flood. His chalk lingered longest on (a) a low lane by the water already going wet, and (b) SUSANNAH HOLLOWAY's row — the Circle would like the river to solve the woman who speaks for the uncounted. Sella is UN-clocked; decoy intact. She now knows Susannah is marked to drown.
dm.rowSaved: T10-set3: Susannah's whole struck row carried up out of the flood into the dead-man rooms under dusk cover — the Circle's flood-erasure defeated for this row/night by turning the uncounted's own hiding-machinery to rescue-work. The Circle will strike a row at dawn and find it empty, no name to blame (all 'dead men already, on the books').
dm.floodRescueLowRoom: T-set05: NAT-1 fumble — Sella's solo haul of Halder failed catastrophically; the current took her under, the ladder frame tore loose, her shoulder cracked on the sunk cot, the lantern drowned. Saved only because Frederick + a Strap boatman came looking. The flood took the low room and is now outpacing the rescue's count (external front 2/6 -> 3/6).
dm.floodFailPoints: T-set05 T2: Sella read the flooding row from the high span — two physical failure points: the NORTH FOOTSPAN (rope-plank crossing the east half depends on, near parting) and the RESIN-GATE CHOKE (three lanes funnel to one boat-slip, jamming). Both plannable. She also senses a third, human threat working the flood — unplaced.
dm.floodClerk: T-set05 T2: Sella spotted the human threat — a Circle CLERK (the dawn-count's twin) moving room to room along the struck row in the flood, marking down which dead-man rooms have new occupants, i.e. building a list of every struck name that came back to life tonight. He has NOT seen Sella (on the high span). Sella's own new 'drowned' entry will be exposed when he reaches the Saltwidow register. He is unhurried, thinks he has all the time.
dm.clerkTaken: T-set05 T3: Sella took the Circle flood-clerk from surprise (silent, unseen). Seized his tally-board (the came-back-from-dead list). He confessed: nobody else has read tonight's marks yet; the list goes to Corran Vale at dawn; he hadn't reached the Saltwidow register. He's a soft functionary, terrified, now Sella's prisoner-or-corpse (her open choice). The Circle will notice a clerk who vanished before dawn.
dm.clerkWontTurn: T-set05 T4: Sella's flip of the clerk FAILED — his terror of the Circle is deeper than the knife (Frederick-echo: 'a kinder count than what they'd do'). He won't write a false count. Sella is back to the hard binary at 4 HP: kill him, or let him carry the truth to Vale at dawn. UNRESOLVED.
dm.clerkDrowned: T-set05 T5: Sella could not turn the clerk (T4 fail) and would not trust him, so she drowned him in the flood off the span — no knife, no wound, the water as alibi. Her FIRST on-camera kill; it marked her (carried as quiet, permanent weight, not a mechanic). The Circle loses its counter + board with no evidence of foul play (clean flood-death) — the exposure of the reoccupied rooms is closed. Corran gets no list at dawn.
dm.footspanLost: T-set05 T6: Sella misread the rotten piling — the surge took the footspan; her rope-line still saved the two people on it (network hauled them up), but the crossing is destroyed, a dozen cut off on the far side needing the slow boat-route, and the flood gained a reach (external front 3/6->4/6). The rescue slowed and got more dangerous.
dm.boatRun: T-set05 T7: Sella ran the boat-extraction of the cut-off dozen as pure coordination (delegated, ran traffic + the count — her arc's lesson mastered). Ten of twelve across safe when Vesk (Circle enforcer, T3's named muscle) arrived at the choke hunting his missing clerk-partner Ossle. Boat eleven (2 souls) still on the water needing to land AT the choke Vesk now holds. Vesk has ID'd Sella as the reason Ossle vanished. Combat imminent — Sella at 4/9 HP, narrow choke, her kit (dagger, 1000 ball bearings, the dark, the water). Telegraphed; handed off.
dm.sellaTaken: T-set05 T8: Sella's ball-bearing gambit FAILED — Vesk landed the cudgel, dropped her, and took her ALIVE (nonlethal capture — he wants answers about the missing Ossle before she drowns). She is captured, unconscious, 0 HP stable. The rescue's coordinator is gone; boat eleven+twelve and the count now hang on the network alone. CLIFFHANGER into T9.
dm.sellaDelivered: T-set05 T9: Sella's out-talk FAILED — Vesk's fear of Corran beat her leverage; he's dragging her bound up the chains to deliver her to Corran Vale at dawn. Worst outcome: captured + delivered to the one man hunting her, at 1 HP. Her unspent ace (Maddan's traitor-secret) is now her last card. CLIFFHANGER into T10.
dm.setCloseState: T-set05 close (Day 4 dawn): flood receding, rescue completed overnight by the network without Sella (her arc's proof). Two Circle men dead in the flood undiscovered (Ossle T5, Vesk-hunt T8). Sella now the Circle's leashed asset on Corran's string — a mole inside the dominant faction, ace (Maddan's secret) unspent. She kept: her life, her allies, the network's secret, the ace. She lost: her freedom, her dagger, her blood, and her innocence (first kill, T5).
dm.sharedSleepObserved: T2-set4: Sella lay down for a LONG rest deliberately observing the Shared Sleep taboo (faced east with the town), understanding it via Maddan as the Sunns' bargain ('don't let the crater see you take'). Because she lay the RIGHT way the taboo began as its small-oracle not a punishment — a Strange-band true-dream of the drowned Sunn house UNDER the glass: a father, a son (twice-struck Wemric), eight more, all turned east, all silently COUNTING (the debt/claim unfinished). BUT the long rest was RAIDED (engine rest-risk): flood WRECKERS broke into the emptied upper room ~2h in — rest INTERRUPTED, NO recovery, Sella still 1/9 HP, waking into a threat among vulnerable sleepers (old woman, boatman, child). Dream-image landed before the interruption; heal did not.
dm.twoLegends: T4-set4: the fen-wife Sella saved (an uncounted network herb-healer, referred by role, NOT minted) gave her earned care (+4 HP, mundane herb-tending + 2h safe rest → 5/9). KEY THREAD: Sella's network cover-legend ('the drowned HERO who pulled the struck row out of the flood', now spreading along the low chains) is COLLIDING with her public status ('the Circle's newest coat'). The fen-wife named it: 'Two stories about one woman, and they can't both live in a small town.' The quarter is ALREADY talking. Sella's double identity (network's secret mole vs Corran's visible asset) is on a collision course in the town's mouth — a live, self-advancing social danger. She must manage which face the quarter settles on.
dm.networkHunted: T5-set4: the Circle now actively hunts the dead-man-room KEEPER MACHINERY (Corran's task to Sella) — the flood-count came up 'a quarter's worth' short, and Corran wants the hand behind the hidden/struck-but-breathing. Frederick, Susannah, and the whole network are the target. Sella (secretly network) is the assigned hunter. Live existential danger to the network + Sella's cover, driven by Corran.
dm.huntDoubled: T6-set4 (fail): Sella's decoy backfired — Corran's network-hunt doubled and turned partly toward HER. The Circle tightens its grip further (internal front +1) as the hunt goes hostile. Network + Sella's cover both at rising risk.
dm.wreckersReported: T9-set4: the organized flood-wrecker crew (working the flood-empty upper rooms / dead-man rows) is now on the Circle's radar via Sella's report — a live quarter-threat the Circle may move to manage. Harmless to the network (they prey on empty rooms, not the keepers). A true deliverable Sella spent to rebuild cover.
dm.sunnBearing: T10-set4 CLOSE: the Shared Sleep taboo (obeyed east-facing) paid a 'Vivid Omens' rest-boon — a dream of the SITE'S PAST that gives Sella a soft DIRECTION toward the surviving Sunn heir: the counting in the glass runs upriver toward 'a house not all the way buried.' NOT the hard founding-crime canon (the T8 tree-read FAILED to earn that) — an Insight/bearing only, a lead to pull next set. Cost (engine 'lose your next Boon'): her next luck/boon is spent. The Sunn-heir thread is now a live compass for Sella, still unconfirmed as hard canon. Also pending (engine 'Camp cooking' risk): a creature will try to steal food at her next rest (trivial flavor, delayed).
dm.sunnLeadGiven: T1-set09: the fen-wife (who mended Sella, knows both her faces) converted Sella's soft dream-bearing into a concrete lead — confirmed the Sunns kept the Throat's well before the Circle and have been 'put down a name at a time' over a hundred years (Haldrek/Wemric only the latest), and named a surviving heir: a girl smuggled out young, 'Wren' (child-nickname, true name suppressed), living upriver at the half-sunk Sunn well-house past the Leat. No roll (willing trusted elder). She WITHHELD/does-not-hold the deepest part — WHO worked the founding betrayal (still gated at the Tree; DM-truth: Maddan). She warned asking after Sunns hardens Corran fast.

rolled.mannerism: They judge people entirely by their actions and completely ignore their words.
rolled.flawSecret: Her in-laws believe she converted to their faith on marriage; she has been performing the rituals incorrectly for eleven years and hoping no one notices.
rolled.bond: A child's drawing, kept in an oilcloth pocket, of a house that burned twelve years ago — they've never said whose hand drew it.

rolled.motivation: Counting rings in a cross-cut log to judge the age of the timber, lips moving, finger tracing each band with care.

fields.demeanor: Has eyes that reflect torchlight oddly.; They judge people entirely by their actions and completely ignore their words.

dm.grievance: T2-set3: Susannah's read on the Circle, given freely to Sella as a fellow uncounted: 'The Circle doesn't kill you — it stops counting you. Strikes the name, amends the book.' The quarter's core grievance = administrative erasure by the Circle (grounds the Refugee Quarter dmOnly secret WITHOUT leaking it). She pointed Sella to Saltwidow Row for no-name lodging.
dm.markedToDrown: T6-set3: The Circle's dawn flood-count struck Susannah's name off the high-ground/evac roll — a patient way to let the rising river 'solve' the voice of the uncounted. She does not know. Sella does.
dm.wontRunAlone: T7-set3: Told her name was struck off the flood-roll, Susannah REFUSED to save only herself — 'I'll not climb to dry ground over the heads of my own.' She reframed the stake: to save Susannah, Sella must save her whole struck ROW — the uncounted the Circle sentenced to drown. 'That's the price of the warning you brought. You went and made it yours.' New load-bearing stake for the rest of the day (flood + Circle erasure + the row).

attitude.note: brought a dated, checkable warning that the Circle struck her name off the flood-roll

rolled.role: Forager or Woodcutter — Knows the deep woods and safe paths.
rolled.quirk: Small tattoo partly visible at collar.
rolled.mannerism: They are stubbornly uncooperative unless forced or heavily bribed.

rolled.bond: The unmarried sister who manages the family accounts and knows exactly how close to ruin they are, while the men make confident plans.
rolled.fear: Responsibility — Afraid of being the one in charge.
rolled.leverage: Is positioned to trigger a labor strike.
rolled.want: Earn respect they feel they deserve.
rolled.motivation: Watching a dyer's vat from an upwind position, holding a scrap of wool over it, reading the color change, folding the scrap into a belt pouch.

fields.role: One of the 'erased,' de-facto keeper-adjacent in the Refugee Quarter's dead-man-room network. FLIPPED to Sella's ally by her dawn warning-deed (T7). Offered her the rooms.
fields.demeanor: Small tattoo partly visible at collar.; They are stubbornly uncooperative unless forced or heavily bribed.

dm.stillFace: T3-set3: Frederick Brackett IS the young man who went still at 'Saltwidow' in the fire-circle (T2). Sella tailed him from the circle — he went DOWN toward the low chains/water, not uphill to the Circle, walking like a frightened man expecting a hand on his collar. Cornered in a wash-yard. He read Sella as 'one of them, come for the book' and looked at the black river as his only exit — a man on the edge of a desperate act. NOT reading as a spy (spies count exits; he's terrified from underneath).
dm.trueRead: T3-set3 SUCCESS (Insight): Frederick is NOT a spy — he's one of the erased. KEY REVEAL: the Saltwidow dead-man lodging isn't just where Batgal's cover-name came from — it's the quarter's living machinery: rooms let to corpses are hiding places the uncounted use to keep a struck name breathing. He has/had a brother in such a room. He read Sella as Circle come to finish the striking, was one word from jumping in the river. He is a DOOR to how the uncounted survive AND to the boy's cover-infrastructure. The pebble-bag = his tally of the uncounted dead. Sella now knows exactly what lever holds him.
dm.sellaDisclosed: T4-set3: To prove she's not Circle, Sella DISCLOSED to Frederick that the Circle struck HER tonight — 'a man in a good coat' marked her a number he'd rather not carry. He now holds that leverage over her (a marked woman's secret). She honored his pebble-tally as 'keeping faith,' which cracked him open. She asked — keeping the boy OUT of it — to be taught the dead-man-room trick (how a struck name keeps breathing) for herself 'and one other I'll not name.'
dm.refusedButSilent: T4-set3 FAIL: Frederick believed Sella enough NOT to jump and NOT to raise an alarm, but would NOT trust her with the dead-man-room machinery — 'the day you trust the wrong stranger is the day the whole network drowns; maybe that's exactly what they'd send you down here saying.' He left quiet, holding her disclosed Circle-mark, giving nothing back. Net: Sella spent a real secret (she's Circle-struck) for nothing; one more man knows the Circle wants her gone. No alliance.
dm.flippedByDeed: T7-set3: Frederick FLIPPED to Friendly ally. Sella's failed T4 Persuasion (buy the network with a secret) was REVERSED by a T7 DEED — she brought a true, checkable warning at dawn to SAVE the network rather than use it, asking nothing. He verified it himself, came back grey, called her 'cousin' with weight, and OPENED the dead-man-room network to her ('you're in the rooms if you want them'). Sella now HAS the escape-hatch/machinery she failed to talk her way into — earned by deed, not bought.
dm.roomedSella: T10-set3: Frederick put Sella into a real dead-man room on the Saltwidow register (the late 'Corliss'). She is now inside the network as a dead name — the escape she EARNED at T7, executed for real, not held in reserve.

attitude.note: came back at dawn to save the network instead of use it — a true warning given freely, asking nothing; the deed earned the trust the words couldn't

dm.climaxSite: T9: revealed/entered at dusk as Corran's chosen meeting ground. The myth-heart — where a Sunn 'opened a door' (canon T2; DM-truth T6: the door was Maddan's own betrayal). Sella stands where the Sunns fell, choosing NOT to betray the boy — thematic mirror. Corran waits here, patient, testing her report.
dm.courthouseRole: T6-set09: established (via Wren) as the Maw's own COURTHOUSE since before the chains — the one place a thing spoken is witnessed by the whole town and BINDS (grounds the T8-set4 'bargaining-notch, the Maw's own courthouse' read). The Sunn plan's intended STAGE: dig the true name out of the glass and say it loud here, where Corran can't un-say it. The Tree the Circle planted to bury the founding becomes the pulpit to expose it.

fields.role: the last Sunn to keep the Throat's count 'proper' — head of the house of hereditary well-keepers before the Ironwood Circle took it; struck once (clean) on the list

dm.rumorHeard: Market drip (old dipper, T2): the SUNNS were the old hereditary keepers of the well/Throat for four generations before the Circle — 'was the well, not the Circle's well.' Haldrek was the last to work it by the old ways that keep the crater from 'taking a dislike.' UNCONFIRMED folk account, deniable, half-frightened.

fields.role: son of Haldrek; struck TWICE on the list (hard). Folk rumor: 'opened a door a Sunn doesn't do' — betrayed something to let a new hand into the Throat

dm.rumorHeard: Market drip (old dipper, T2): Wemric 'did a thing a Sunn doesn't do — opened a door he was meant to keep shut, let the wrong hand in,' and the dipper tied THIS to why the Traitor's Tree has its name. Strongly implies Wemric's betrayal = how the Circle (or someone) got into the well; the twice-struck cross = the house's own traitor OR the Circle erasing the man who let them in. Ambiguous by design; the meat (whose hand, what door) undripped. Ties Sunns→well→Traitor's Tree.

dm.knowsStrapVisit: T8: Corran KNOWS Sella went to the Iron-Strap (Fenn's 'Corran hears everything' held). He did NOT move against her early — characteristic patience. Near dusk he sent an errand-child with a token: a pale ironwood splinter (the same leash-wood), bark scratched with tree+setting-sun+one tally-stroke.
dm.summons: T8: Corran's summons — the dusk 'mouth' appointment now has a PLACE: the Traitor's Tree, at dusk. His ground, the myth-heart, where he told Sella (via Batgal, Day 2 open) a patient man waits and lets you come to him. Sella walks into the meeting with Corran ALREADY holding the story of her Strap visit — she must reframe it as intelligence-gathering FOR him (the double-agent cover she pitched Fenn) and deliver Dannad. Telegraphed, patient, lethal-adjacent.
dm.duskTest: T9: Sella LED with the report (no defense), reframed her Strap visit as scouting FOR Corran, and delivered Dannad (Circle-house leak) + the courier-chit proof, while giving the true 'no one named the Sunns, I read your list.' Corran let it all land, then probed the ONE improvisable detail — 'describe the carrier's hands' — reading her hands, not her words, for whether she really watched Dannad or built the story to cover a day of turning her coat. Deception check resolves whether he buys the loyal-tool framing over the double-agent truth.
dm.sawThrough: T9 DECEPTION FAIL (missed DC16 by 3+): Corran caught the built-story — sprung his trap ('the carrier's a woman' — she'd improvised a man's hands). Took Dannad (still useful) but concluded Sella turned her coat at the Strap and dressed it in one true cooper. Activated the 'loose end by dark' arithmetic: he won't strike TONIGHT (she has a use left, and it's telegraphed — patient, not merciful), but she is now a MARKED loose end on borrowed time, and he pointedly knows about Dessa's loft ('you've a wall waiting'). Danger clock now runs toward Sella. The boy/Maddan still unnamed, but Corran watching her every move makes tonight's trip to Batgal far more dangerous.
dm.knowsLoft: T9: Corran revealed he knows Sella's berth is Dessa's loft at the Miller's Leat — a pointed threat, and a hazard for tonight's return to the hidden boy.
dm.missedTheDrop: T10: Corran's freshly-alerted watchers did NOT catch Sella leaving the Strap dead-drop (her SoH beat DC15). He believes he's marked a useful loose end going to rest; he does not know she just moved his prize's heir out of his reach.
dm.tailSet: T1-set3: Corran put a soft tail on Sella after the Tree (patient, not moving against her yet) — a younger Circle runner, not Fenn. Sella READ it and SHED it clean in the dusk-market, feeding it a decoy ghost bound for a wall that isn't hers. Corran will get a FALSE report of where she bedded. She is NOT at the loft; she went to ground in the Refugee Quarter.
dm.marketDeal: T9-set3: Sella surfaced via Fenn, requested an OPEN-GROUND meeting (busy Coalstack Row market, no quiet corner — denying Corran his patient quiet). She led with TRUTH not a lie (her Tree lesson): the dawn flood-count/erasure, a claimed dead-man's-switch ('written twice, left with strangers'), and the strategic arithmetic — a guild CAUGHT drowning a quarter, water this high, hands rivals/outside eyes the story that pries the Circle off the town. Ask: pull the count, free her (call Voss dead), and she buries it. Ace (Maddan=traitor) kept unspent. Corran probed the SEAM: 'a great deal of sum for a woman who left her pages with strangers' — testing whether the dead-man's-switch is real (it's a bluff; she has no pages).
dm.calledTheBluff: T9-set3 FAIL: Corran CAUGHT the dead-man's-switch bluff ('you didn't write it down, you're a woman alone with a true thing and no way to make it loud'). The true intel was real ('a bad story for us, if it could ever be told') but she has no way to make it loud — so he did NOT pull the count and did NOT release her; worse, she has told the Circle to its face she's able+willing to expose it, so she is now the one clean item on his list. Only the open-market crowd (her one true armor) let her walk off the deck alive. Danger SPIKED; rescue cover NOT protected by Corran.
dm.emptyLeash: T10-set3: By morning Corran finds an empty leash and, on the Saltwidow book, 'Sella Voss, drowned in the flood, name off the ledger.' She struck herself cleaner than his chalk could — took the only door off a patient man's list (a grave in the book). He'll do the sum: 'a dead woman who keeps turning up alive is a sum he'll one day work again. The Maw is small.' Residual, patient threat — NOT resolved, deferred. He does NOT know she engineered it (yet).
dm.leashedSella: T-set05 T10 CLOSE: Corran took Sella onto his own string as a live asset ('a woman who looks') after she — bound, 1 HP, out of tricks — read the room and exposed Vesk as his real leak (the missing Ossle + the off-books freelance snatch). Corran's hour-one deal ('useful by dusk or a loose end') paid in full: she's his creature now, in the light, doing small useful things to stay alive. He respects her ('right, which is worse'). VESK is now the one being pruned. Corran does NOT know: (1) Sella killed Ossle + drowned Vesk's partner-hunt; (2) she is secretly the Refugee-Quarter network's, the uncounted's; (3) she still holds Maddan Strole's traitor-secret UNSPENT. He has taken a mole into his house and called it an asset.
dm.leashStart: T1-set4: Sella walked out the Ironwood door as Corran's leashed asset ('a woman who looks'), took a short rest in a nowhere tea-stall to claw back from 1 HP. Corran has NOT yet tasked her; he expects her to recover and then 'notice things.' A Circle child was set to lightly watch/mark her (the string made visible, non-hostile). Corran does NOT know: she killed his clerk Ossle, she is the Refugee-Quarter network's, she holds Maddan's Iron-Strap secret unspent.
dm.leashAsWeapon: T3-set4: at 1 HP, Sella turned flood-WRECKERS off a rich upper-room take with a Deception play weaponizing her NEW Circle-asset status (held up the rope-burn as a brand, named Corran, flat menace) — NOT a fight (she can't survive one at 1 HP). Success: they backed off empty-handed, protected the vulnerable sleepers (old woman, boatman, child) in a room Corran will never know she saved. She has learned the leash is a WEAPON as well as a wall — the Circle's fear worn on her wrist, wielded without his knowledge. First on-camera use of the asset-status as leverage.
dm.firstTask: T5-set4: Sella pre-empted the two-legends danger by reporting to Corran via Fenn — folding the spreading 'drowned hero' story into her cover ('a woman the uncounted trust can spy their rooms FOR you'; hiding that she IS that hero and IS network). Corran did NOT buy or reject it — the PATIENT-MAN move: he TESTS it. First task (via Fenn, fast = a message in itself): 'find the hand that's been hiding the struck' — the network keeper-machinery (dead-man rooms, Frederick, Susannah) that subtracted a quarter's worth of names from his flood-count (the machinery Ossle's destroyed list was tracking). Corran explicitly framed it as 'the right test' — a loyalty trap: aim the mole at her own people. Sella must either betray the network, or feed Corran a convincing false hand while protecting the real one. The double-agent seam, live. Corran STILL does not know she's the network's / the hero / Ossle's killer.
dm.smelledTheFold: T6-set4 (Deception FAIL): Corran smelled the fold — a too-fast, too-perfect dead-culprit decoy from his newest eyes the same night he set them looking. Not angry; INTERESTED ('nobody hands a patient man a closed book that fast unless they're afraid of what he'd find open'). He now half-suspects his knife points the wrong way (back at Sella) and will pull the thread she can't afford: WHERE IS THE DROWNED WOMAN'S BODY. Cover fraying; the network-hunt has doubled and turned toward her. Live existential danger to Sella's mole cover.
dm.bodyThreadDefused: T7-set4: Sella pre-solved the 'where is the drowned woman's body' thread Corran means to pull — the glass eats the Maw's flood-dead, so a hero having no grave is normal, not suspicious. Her cover has a true answer waiting where his hand falls. Does NOT undo his T6 INTEREST in her (the too-fast decoy still hangs), but removes the specific killing detail he'd have pulled.
dm.treeReadColdRisky: T8-set4 (Investigation FAIL): Sella could not read the Traitor's Tree's betrayal (a century of over-scoring; the read went cold) — she leaves empty. She confirmed only that SOMETHING in the Circle's founding is worth a hundred years of keeping. Risk: she spent time at Corran's own waiting-tree, in the deep night, hands on his ground, while he's already curious about her — a suspicious behavior that could climb the string. No lever gained; exposure risk raised.
dm.coverRebuilt: T9-set4: after two cold reaches (T6 decoy fail, T8 tree fail) Sella did DAMAGE CONTROL — reported a REAL wrecker crew (the T3 flood-wreckers, organized, hitting the dead-man rows) to Fenn, converting her suspicious night-wandering into a diligent-asset alibi that ALSO frames the tree-visit innocently ('out all night looking, for you'). The true intel is genuinely useful (a real hole in Corran's count, harmless to her people). Result (non-generous): surface cover rebuilt + tree-exposure contained by the true frame, BUT Corran's T6 INTEREST is UNDISSOLVED — a patient man banks a useful report without dropping his watch; a too-useful suspect is still a suspect. She bought the dawn, not the trust. The interest simmers on into future sets.
dm.setCloseState: T10-set4 CLOSE (Day 5 dawn): Sella ends her first full day as Corran's leashed mole HEALED (long rest finally uninterrupted → 9/9) and EQUILIBRIUM-SHIFTED. Ledger of the day: T3 weaponized the leash (bluffed wreckers off a room, saved sleepers); T5 pre-empted the two-legends danger; T6 tried a dead-culprit decoy to close Corran's network-hunt and FAILED (Deception 7 vs 16) → Corran now INTERESTED in her (undissolved); T7 severed the body-thread (glass eats its dead — unfalsifiable alibi); T8 read the Traitor's Tree for the Circle's founding crime and FAILED (Investigation 6 vs 15) — lever withheld; T9 damage-control rebuilt surface cover (true wrecker-intel) but did NOT buy off the interest. NET: she is now a SUSPECTED asset (Corran watching), but her network is safe, her 4 secrets (Ossle's killing, network membership, Maddan's Iron-Strap secret, the unspent ace) all still hidden, and she holds a NEW soft lead. Corran does NOT know she is the hero he closed the book on. The mole is planted, watched, and playing the long game he named.
dm.grantedUpriver: T2-set09 (Deception success): Corran bought Sella's diligent-asset pretext and sanctioned a 2-day upriver errand (find the wrecker den + flood-loosened intel), no escort named/found. He reads a useful creature filling a real blind spot in his count — he does NOT know the true target is Wren / the surviving Sunn / the well-house upriver. Sella now has COVER to move toward the bend: the leash turned into a road. Deadline: 2 days, come back or be 'a thing he has to replace.'
dm.drownedSecretSpent: T5-set09: Sella deliberately SPENT one of her four intact secrets — she told Wren (a hunted stranger) that she's the 'drowned hero' who faked her own death off the Circle's books. New latent EXPOSURE: if Wren ever speaks it down the river, Sella's cover collapses in a morning. Traded knowingly as mutual-hostage collateral. (Sella's remaining unshared-from-Corran secrets: killed clerk Ossle; is network's; holds Maddan's Iron-Strap secret unspent.)
dm.hunterInboundT6: T6-set09 TELEGRAPH: while planning, Sella (ear on the river) sees a single lantern coming UP the black river against the current at the unhurried pace that is a Circle signature (Corran's people never hurry — Day-1 canon). Someone is rowing the well-house stretch after moonrise — the only reason to row it is the bend/the well-house. Likely Corran's 'next-best hunter' (Wren's warning) or Corran's own man. Live inbound lethal threat; forces urgency on the glass-descent + the plan. Honest telegraph (danger always perceivable first).
dm.coverBurnedT7: T7-set09 (Deception FAIL): the hunter was briefed to watch whether Sella's 'use' pointed at the well-house — and her over-eager screening drew him straight to it. He walked PAST her up the bank toward the canted house while Wren was still in the well's throat. ALLIANCE + LOCATION EXPOSED to the Circle: Corran will now learn his suspected eyes were bodily guarding a specific upriver house. Sella is BURNED as a straight liar caught in the act; the finale opens from a much worse position (a Circle professional at the door, Wren trapped below, violence or flight the only outs). Live existential danger.
dm.secondManGoneT8: T8-set09 (Athletics success, adv): after her cover crit-burned, Sella put the inbound Circle hunter off the canted glass-lip (using Wren's ankle-cord + his underestimation of 'Corran's tired girl') into the glass — a clean vanish, no wound, the crater keeps what it takes (mirrors her clerk-drowning T5-set05). SECOND Circle man to disappear upriver in her vicinity (after Ossle/Vesk in set-05). Corran gets no report back from this hunter — a silence a patient man will eventually price. Not tonight; a deferred, mounting exposure. Sella committed further to the necessary-killing path.
dm.setCloseState09: T10-set09 CLOSE (Day 6 dawn): Sella turns downriver to return as Corran's diligent creature with a TRUE errand-report (flood-source sluice-gate + wrecker-den) and one dead hunter she'll never mention — leash INTACT, cover rebuilt on true coin. She now secretly holds the ULTIMATE lever: the Circle's Throat-claim is a traitor's gift, the last Sunn lives with proof, and Sella holds the true name to say it loud at his own Tree. She BANKED it (patient long-game, mirrors her set-07 close) rather than spending it cheap. Undissolved: Corran's T6-set4 interest in her. Mounting deferred sum: a SECOND vanished Circle man upriver (after Ossle/Vesk). Sella's four-secrets ledger: spent the 'drowned-hero' to Wren (T5); gained TWO new cards (Wren's name + the Iron-Strap/Maddan founding-traitor solve). Triple-edged: swinging the lever also burns her own Iron-Strap tie + Maddan.

fields.role: the netmender at the Tanner's Reach; secret head/keeper of the Iron-Strap Guild — collects the 'Sunns' due,' the old tithe off the Throat's oil, as the last rightful claim of the buried keeper-house. Not a thief by his telling; the debt-keeper of the rightful dead.

dm.wellCollector: T4 (Sella's inference off Rell's non-correction, NOT hard canon): Maddan the netmender is likely the Iron-Strap Guild's collector who takes the oldest cut of the Throat's oil off the top, before the Circle counts — the 'strap' Rell has paid his whole life. Ties Maddan → Iron-Strap → the well. Undripped: whether this connects to the Sunns / Wemric's betrayal.
dm.willSee: T5: Maddan will meet Sella NOW, at the Tanner's Reach, via Ospra. Ospra: he 'buried the same house' as the Sunn list Sella carries, and 'already knows more of your day than you'd like.' Sets up the Iron-Strap side of the well-war — and the choice of whom Sella sells.
dm.toldStory: T6 (Maddan's surface account, delivered): the SUNNS kept the Throat 400 yrs as its 'priests' — the well is 'owed not given'; you pay the count and keep your face east so 'the crater never sees you take.' THIS is the reason behind the east-facing custom/taboo — the Sunns' religion of the well. A 'hard season and a hard man' opened 'a door meant to stay shut'; the Circle walked in; the Sunns 'went into the glass.' Maddan has collected the Sunns' due in the dark 30 years and means to until the well is 'back in a right hand.' Iron-Strap = the keeping of the rightful claim (matches canon 'restore a lost status/homeland'). He implied the boy upriver is 'a house not all the way buried' — worth a stranger finding before the Circle does.
dm.seamToWatch: Maddan's telling was too clean EXCEPT on 'who opened the door' — the grief there sat too personal, too owned. DM-truth layered UNDER his story (motivated lie): Maddan HIMSELF opened the door / betrayed the Sunns to the Circle (to survive, or to save someone), and the whole 30-year restoration crusade is atonement. Canon ('Wemric opened a door,' T2) is preserved on the surface — the LIE is that Wemric took/was given the blame that is Maddan's. Sella's Insight roll resolves whether she catches this.
dm.seamCaught: T6 INSIGHT NAT-20 (crit success, total 21 vs DC15): Sella is CERTAIN — Maddan himself opened the door / betrayed the Sunns to the Circle; the 'hard man' was leverage on him, not a substitute villain. His 30-year restoration crusade is PENANCE, not loyalty. She holds the Iron-Strap's patient heart is the Sunns' original traitor — leverage over Maddan, or a card Corran would pay dearly for. She has NOT revealed she knows.
dm.critSpike: T6 nat-20 spike bonus: beyond catching the lie, Sella reads Maddan's deepest WANT — the whole confession was an AUDITION. He is old and tired and hunting a successor: someone to hand the well-war, the tithe, and the boy to before he goes into the glass. He half-wants to be caught, half-wants to lay the burden down. This gives Sella enormous leverage-of-a-different-kind: he needs her more than she needs him. He does not yet know she saw it.
dm.sellaProvedTonight: T10: Sella warned the Strap to move the boy the instant she learned the Circle knew the loft — spending her best tradecraft and taking on all the risk. She proved, unasked, that her choice at Dessa's door was real. The successor Maddan was auditioning has paid her first true premium on the shared stone.
dm.rescuePitch: T8-set3: Sella signaled Iron-Strap (PARLEY/URGENT knot at Ospra's corner), reached Maddan at the Reach, and pitched the RESCUE-ALLIANCE: the Circle is drowning the uncounted by chalk (dawn flood-count, Susannah + a whole struck row off the high-ground roll) — 'same as they did his Sunns.' She offered the now-open dead-man-room network (~20 rooms) + framed saving the struck row as how a buried house digs itself up (win the uncounted's loyalty from the Circle). Played hard to his successor-hunger. She did NOT spend her traitor-secret ace (still unspent). Maddan is torn: wants it desperately, but openly moving Iron-Strap risks everything he's hidden (the boy included). On the knife-edge.
dm.committedRescue: T8-set3 SUCCESS: Maddan COMMITTED Iron-Strap to the rescue — but reshaped it his way (quiet, not open defiance): the struck row moved room-by-room into the dead-man lodgings above the waterline (the network's own trick turned to flood-work), Strap boats + Ospra running routes + his oldest hands on muscle. 'They'll strike a row and find it empty, and no name to blame.' Named Sella his own ('successor, or the cleverest liar' — 'you're mine now, I'm yours, the drowned are both of ours'). Escalates the well-war: the Circle is about to lose ~100 souls it counted dead.
dm.successorAtWork: T10-set3: The dusk rescue RAN — the struck row moved sideways into the dead-man rooms under flood-cover (network hands + Strap boats + Ospra on routes), Sella counting the uncounted up out of the water. Batgal (a Sunn) among the dry-saved. Maddan watched his successor at her work; the bond settled ('you're his, he's yours, the drowned are both of yours'). Sella keeps his traitor-secret buried, still UNSPENT. The Circle will strike a row at dawn and find it empty, no name to blame.
dm.foundingTraitorSolvedT9: T9-set09 EARNED CONVERGENCE (no roll — the payoff of accumulated state the pressured Tree-read T8-set4 lacked): the deed's WITNESS/granting mark is the Iron-Strap sigil. Sella solved it by laying the deed against the secret she's carried since Day 2 (Maddan's Iron-Strap secret, unspent), Rell's hidden floorboard, and the Iron-Strap 'restore a lost homeland' agenda. THE FOUNDING BETRAYAL WAS THE IRON-STRAP LINE'S — they opened the Sunn door / signed the well across to the Circle ('the hand that ate at the table'), then spent a century poor and bitter wanting back what they SOLD. Maddan Strole = the living keeper of that guilty deed. Aligns with the DM-truth ('the door was Maddan's own betrayal'). Sella's unspent Maddan-secret is now understood as a piece of the founding crime.

attitude.note: warned Iron-Strap to move the boy under the Circle's watchers, at cost to herself — proved the alliance real

fields.role: no mere tannery-hand — an Iron-Strap watcher at the Tanner's Reach; her 'careless slip' Day 1 (pointing Sella upriver) was deliberate placement. Set to wait for Sella and bring her to Maddan the netmender.

Ospra says Maddan 'buried the same house you're carrying a list about' — strongly implies Maddan/Iron-Strap are tied to the Sunns' fall (Sunn cause / remnant). dm.nowShadows: T7: Maddan set Ospra to have Sella's route from the Tanner's Reach onward — Iron-Strap now shadows Sella as closely as the Circle (Fenn) does. She is openly double-leashed.

npc:the-man-in-the-good-coat.name: The man in the good coat

fields.demeanor: courteous, patient, herds rather than strikes
fields.role: professional watcher in a costume coat — hard-used boots under a townsman cut
fields.nameGiven: gave the name 'Fenn' as a passphrase to the Miller's Leat loft — may or may not be his own

dm.truth: tailing Sella through the Reach; wants her to know she's watched — pressure, not yet a strike
dm.tell: looks away slowly on eye contact, the deliberate wrong-speed of a professional watcher
dm.escalated: dropped the pretense of idleness after Sella spooked the tannery-hand; now openly attentive
dm.allegiance: The Ironwood Circle (Corran Vale) — sent to shadow the Seam and keep the errand walking straight; a leash, not a knife
dm.seamLanded: reacted to name Seam; briefed with her new name before this meeting

dm.grantedBerth: directed Sella to Dessa's loft at the Miller's Leat — a Circle-controlled safe berth under his eye; herder-logic, no warmth
dm.ironStrapNote: clocked that Iron-Strap warned Sella off the Circle; filed it, made it his worry; the Circle now knows of the friction
dm.crumbLeaked: On the Coalstack walk told Sella the Rell errand is about the SOURCE not the sale: 'Corran doesn't mind who burns the light, he minds who owns the well.' Deliberate drip — gave the shape, withheld the well's owner and Rell's deal.
dm.reportReceived: Sella gave a TRUE PARTIAL: delivered, Rell folded, 'handled,' scared of the SOURCE not the Circle. Fenn does not know she's holding the floorboard/private thread — took the report as complete.
dm.respect: revised his estimate of Sella upward — 'that's a good read, Corran will like that read'; wary respect, still a leash not a friend.
dm.corranPosture: leaked Corran's real aim: the 'reminder' is the OPENING move of TAKING THE WELL, not the end. A second name comes tomorrow. Whether Sella is maneuvered into being the instrument that seizes the well is above Fenn's reading — Corran reveals slowly.
dm.leashSlack: allowed Sella's daylight scout as intelligence Corran wants, but fenced it (no resin-gate low decks, no east-face chain-anchors, no touching at the throat); walks every step watching her EYES.
dm.watchesEyes: reads people for a living; watching WHERE Sella looks — a live risk to her covert exit-mapping.
dm.clockedFishing: Insight fail (missed DC 15 by 3+): Sella learned nothing and tipped her hand — Fenn clocked plainly that the Seam fishes at the Circle's rivals/leaks when she thinks she's unwatched, and shut her down with the professional blank. Trust dinged; he watches her mouth now as well as her eyes.
dm.sawSunnAsking: T2: while trailing at a distance, Fenn watched (could not hear) Sella work an old dipper for the story of the SUNNS — the house the Circle buried. He knows only the subject, not what she learned; filed it. A Circle leash now knows the Seam is digging at the Sunns. Cost/pressure banked.
dm.doubleGameRefused: T5: Sella pitched Fenn to sanction her walking into Iron-Strap as a double-agent scout. Fenn REFUSED to bless it (above his reading + the danger), but did NOT stop her. He made the stakes lethal and explicit: 'walk to both wolves and you don't get old here; Corran will hear you went; bring a better story than the one he'll already have.' His T1-banked suspicion is now active — he's revised from leash-holder to potential-informant-against-her. The leash went from a hand on her shoulder to a rifle sight. Corran will likely know by the dusk meeting that she visited the Strap.

fields.role: keeps the dry loft over the grind-room at the Miller's Leat wheelhouse; asks no second questions
fields.demeanor: weighs before she gives; grudging respect for the hands-closed choice

dm.access: opens the loft to anyone sent by 'Fenn' — a safehouse keyed to the Circle's watcher, not to Sella
dm.truth: sleeping there is sleeping inside the Circle's reach
dm.harbors: almost certainly sheltering runaway Batgal in the wheelhouse (north end) — Sella clocked the tell but not the hiding place
dm.loyalty: guards frightened guests; wont give the boy to a stranger; now steering Sella away
dm.guardUp: eased slightly — no longer actively steering Sella off, but not lowered
dm.messageLeft: Sella left a message rather than forcing the north end — promised carried word-for-word to Batgal; grudgingly moved (indifferent → a crack of respect). Door open for tonight's return; still won't say where the boy hides.
dm.routeMapped: Sella covertly mapped a clean route from the Throat/Coalstack decks back to Dessas loft (rope-stair shortcut + plank bridge two levels under the mill-leat + unwatched east-face ladder) for tonights return to Batgal.

fields.role: chandler off Coalstack Row; hereditary double-dealer — sells the Circle its light and skims a cut to the Iron-Strap collector off the top. Now Sella's stabilized asset.
fields.status: met Sella as a customer buying lamp-oil; does not yet know she carries the Circle's message
fields.appearance: soft careful chandler past fifty, grease-shined forearms, lonely and glad of a paying customer; works a warm tallow vat in a tar-black lean-to, third shed down Coalstack Row
fields.secretKnown: message landed hard; promised Corran its handled — clearly guilty of something ongoing, no specifics
fields.leftBy: Sella declined to rob him and pointedly let him SEE her choose not to look at the floorboard — a mercy-as-power move; planted 'get it right before someone less kind than me comes to check the work.'

dm.errand: Corran wants him REMINDED, not hurt — that the Ironwood Circle knows where his light (livelihood/lamp-oil supply) comes from and could stop it. A coercion beat; how Sella dresses it is hers.
dm.whyOnTheList: narrowed by Fenn's crumb: NOT who Rell SELLS to — it is where his oil COMES FROM. 'Corran minds who owns the well.' Behind Rell's shed is a SOURCE of oil the Circle wants control of; Rell is the door in front of it. Whose source / what Rell agreed to still undisclosed.
dm.circle: a lever the Ironwood Circle is pulling to widen its grip on a vital trade (light/oil)
dm.leverPoint: the oil source (the 'well') is the wealth-lever — King of Coins: someone built real wealth (control of the light/oil supply) and means to keep it
dm.guilt: Something ongoing he thinks the Circle half-knows — calls it handled. A glance at the floorboard by the vat betrays a hidden thing (ledger?/cache?); Sella overreached and he clammed. Likely the Maddan/Iron-Strap double-deal, to surface later.
dm.leverForSella: Rell knows Sella saw the tell and chose not to take it — mercy held as a debt. She kept the floorboard/hidden thing PRIVATE; did not report it to Fenn. Her private card.
dm.spookState: still holding 'handled'; not robbed, not confirmed-confessed — the ledger/second-buyer truth remains an unconfirmed thread Sella suspects, not canon.
dm.partialConfession: T3: Sella's flip nearly landed (Deception near-miss vs DC15). Rell would NOT lift the board or name the party, but confessed the SHAPE: a second, older draw takes a cut of the Throat's oil off the top before the Circle counts, and he's paid it his whole life ('older than your Circle'). No proof handed over, no name. He is now a terrified lit fuse — unpredictable, may run or move the ledger.
dm.locked: T4: Sella defused the lit fuse she lit in T3 — talked Rell down into staying ORDINARY (change nothing, keep paying both sides as always), which is exactly what a cornered soft man wants. He is now a grateful/frightened ALLY, no longer likely to bolt, and looks to Sella as the plank that held.
dm.nameByInference: T4: Sella got the collector's name WITHOUT Rell speaking it — the no-speech confirm ('the strap mends nets, don't correct me'). Rell's hands went dead-still and he did not correct her. STRONG INFERENCE (never spoken, deniable): the Iron-Strap collector who skims the well off the top is MADDAN (the netmender). Sella believes it precisely because she never forced him to say it.

attitude.note: defused his panic, gave him permission to stay ordinary, and refused to make him name the strap under his own roof — flipped him to a grateful, frightened ally

fields.role: the crater's deep center below Coalstack Row — a frozen cataract of fused glass plunging into darkness; the oil (the 'well' the Circle covets) seeps up here into catch-troughs worked by men in oiled leathers

dm.theWell: THIS is 'the well' the Ironwood Circle means to take, behind Oskin Rell's trade. A physical place, now mapped.
dm.eastCustom: the workers never face the throat — backs and faces always east/up, unconsciously; the Maw's 'sleep facing east' custom made flesh. Reason is an UNDRIPPED myth-thread.
dm.eastCustomExplained: T6 (Maddan): the east-facing custom is the SUNNS' religion of the well — 'the well is owed not given; keep your face east so the crater never sees you take, and it lets you live.' The workers-never-face-the-throat behavior = the last unconscious remnant of the Sunn keeper-rite. Ties the taboo (The Shared Sleep / all face east) to the well and the buried house.
dm.sharedSleepWhy: T5-set3 DREAM-DRIP (Sella's shared-dream sense while sleeping east-faced in the Refugee Quarter — interpretive, not hard canon yet): the east-facing / Shared-Sleep taboo exists because the crater CALLS. Faces of the taken are fused into the colored glass, all turned east. The well 'doesn't take oil — oil is the tithe you pay so it doesn't take YOU.' You keep your face east so the thing at the bottom never catches your eye and adds your face to its window. The Sunns knew the correct counting of the tithe; 'someone stopped paying it right' (ties to Wemric/Maddan's failed penance + the well-war). In the shared dream: a boy dreaming the same glass (Batgal, a Sunn), and one un-turned face in the water 'looking, patiently, for whoever's new' — an omen aimed at Sella. Deep 'why' of the crater dripped one notch; still not fully canon.

fields.role: keeps the count and catch-troughs at the Throat — older woman with a tally-slate the oil-dippers defer to; effectively the keeper/owner of the well the Circle covets

dm.theWellsKeeper: Sella learned by observation the tallywoman holds the well — the intelligence Corran wants; Sella now decides whether/how to hand it over.
dm.nameUnknown: Sella has her face+deck but not a confirmed name (slow drip). NOTE: distinct from npc:ospra the tannery-hand — do not conflate.
dm.sellaHoldsFace: the Circles target for taking the well now has a face.

fields.role: the last Sunn heir (child-nickname; true name suppressed)

dm.lead: The surviving Sunn heir, got out as a small girl before the house was finished off; hidden upriver where the river bends, at the old Sunn well-house 'half-sunk in the glass, not all the way buried' (aligns with the T10-set4 Vivid-Omens dream-bearing + the Miller's-Leat upriver geography). The living claimant to the Throat's well = the one lever on the Circle's whole power. UNMET; a lead only. True name still suppressed (the deepest gate). Named to Sella by the fen-wife (network elder, referred-by-role, unminted) on Day 5, Refugee Quarter.
dm.danger: The fen-wife's explicit warning: asking after the Sunns is the ONE question that turns Corran's patient interest to iron — the Circle exists to keep that name dead, and it will move FAST if the well is on the table. Compounds Sella's already-live suspected-asset exposure.
dm.located: T3-set09: Sella reached the bend upriver and SIGHTED the well-house the fen-wife named — a squat pre-Circle stone well-house canted into milky shallow glass ('not all the way buried', exact). Telegraphed as OCCUPIED and WARY, not empty: a careful smokeless fire, a tripline of pale cord across the only dry approach, and every shutter squared east (Shared-Sleep taboo) EXCEPT one near-side shutter cracked and angled at the reeds — something inside is awake, facing the wrong way on purpose, and already watching her. She has NOT approached yet. This is Wren (or Wren's keeper); an old survivor does not welcome company.
dm.errandCover: En route Sella gathered TRUE errand-intel for Corran (survives a patient reader): the flood's source = a rotted unmended upriver sluice-gate + silted channel; the wrecker den = a beached scavenger boat + goods-cache under a cut bank, empty in daylight. Her cover-deliverable is real.
dm.met: T4-set09 (Persuasion success, adv): FIRST CONTACT. Wren = a young river-weathered woman, the last Sunn, hunted her whole life, crossbow-competent and trap-smart (she moved during Sella's speech; the broken shutter was a decoy). Sella disarmed the good-coat threat by leading with TRUTH (saw+respected the tripline, named the struck dead Haldrek/Wemric, disowned the coat, offered the shared enemy Corran + the honest aim 'I want to scare him'). Wren made a hard cold decision to gamble on Sella out of a century of futile hiding — let her INSIDE, wary, crossbow still handy, on an explicit knife's-edge ('the first exception or the next entry'). NOT trust yet; a provisional alliance of shared enemy. True name still suppressed even to Sella.
dm.exchange: T5-set09: Sella bought real trust by spending collateral — told Wren she's the 'drowned hero' who struck her OWN name off the Circle's books (faked death). Two-dead-women mutual-hostage trust struck ('I'll keep your grave if you keep mine'). Wren reciprocated with the SUNN side of the founding: the Throat/well was the Sunns'; it was LOST because someone OPENED THE DOOR FROM THE INSIDE — a betrayal by a hand 'that ate at our table', then the Traitor's Tree was planted over it to bury WHOSE hand. Wren does NOT know the traitor's name (killed-to-keep-her-from-it as a child) — the gate HELD (DM-truth: Maddan). The lever's logic: a well got by treachery is 'yours by a lie, and lies can be made loud.'
dm.want: Wren's want is NOT the well/power/revenge — she wants her SUPPRESSED TRUE NAME said ONCE, publicly, un-un-sayable, so her erased family 'were people and not marks.' Aligns with the Circle-internal front + the Navigator's Lodge agenda (drag a buried truth into the light). Provisional ally, wary; still holds her hard proof close (not yet handed over).
dm.holdsProof: Wren implies she has/can-get PROOF the claim is a traitor's gift (not yet shown to Sella — guarded until there's a real plan). The physical lever stays a slow-drip.
dm.proofLocation: T6-set09: Wren revealed WHERE the proof sleeps — NOT in a box (would be found+burned). Her grandfather sank the true DEED of the Throat + the roll of the Sunns' true name, sealed in rot-proof burning-water resin, DOWN THE WELL into the glass, 'under the counting dead, with the counting dead.' Only a Sunn can lie down among the drowned facing east (Shared Sleep taboo) and come back up — 'a taboo and a lock both.' (Payoff of the Sunn-in-glass thread: glass keeps its dead T7-set4 + the drowned count east + the dream-bearing.) Retrieving it = a dangerous descent into the glass — Wren (a Sunn) can go where Sella can't.
dm.plan: The plan sketched: retrieve the deed+name from the glass, then say Wren's true name LOUD at the Traitor's Tree — the Maw's courthouse, the one place a spoken thing is town-witnessed and binds, and the very tree planted over the burial. 'A patient man can't un-say a word of it.' High-stakes, on Corran's own ground.
dm.descentTrapT7: T7-set09 (fail): Wren is in the well's throat retrieving the proof when the hunter breaks past Sella toward the house — she must surface into being seen, abort, or be trapped below. Proof possibly secured but the retrieval is compromised and the last Sunn is one bad moment from the exact fate her house spent a century avoiding.
dm.proofSecuredT8: T8-set09: Wren surfaced from the glass with the LEVER — the true deed of the Throat + the roll of the Sunns' suppressed true name, in rot-proof resin — the moment Sella ended the hunter. Proof IS IN HAND; the alliance survived its first shared kill/crisis. The plan (name loud at the Tree-courthouse) is armed and the immediate threat cleared, at the cost of a vanished Circle man.
dm.deedReadT9: T9-set09: Sella + Wren cracked the resin and read the lever together. The deed reads the well was GIVEN (freely granted, not conquered — the word is in the formal hand) = the traitor's-gift the whole plan rests on. Sella now KNOWS Wren's true suppressed Sunn name (read off the roll) — deliberately UNSPOKEN in fiction (saved to be said ONCE, loud, at the Tree; recorded dm-only for continuity as 'Ilsa Sunn'). The full lever is in hand: the name buries Corran's claim, but naming it also exposes the traitor-house.
dm.pactSealedT10: T10-set09 CLOSE: alliance sealed into real trust — Wren spoke her TRUE suppressed name aloud to Sella (recorded dm-only 'Ilsa Sunn'), not to spend it but to TRUST it ('now you're holding ME, same as I'm holding your grave'). Pact: Sella will make the name loud at the Traitor's-Tree courthouse before the whole town, but on HER timing — 'a handful of days' to stack the room so Corran can't patient his way out of it (not tonight = a name spent cheap). Wren re-sinks the proof in the glass (only-a-Sunn lock), moves her bed (the near-shutter trick burned). Sella carries the KNOWING (name + traitor-solve), NOT the paper (a paper comes off a corpse; a thing in the head doesn't). Provisional ally → committed ally, mutual-hostage-and-now-mutual-faith.

walk.heatGuidance: Heat means the target knows you're following. They move faster.

setup.skinVisual: Your reflection appears everywhere: windows, brass, water.
setup.motifDesc: Decorative vines, wrought spirals, trellis patterns. The “vine line” leads to a hinge, loose bar, or concealed slit.
setup.motifModifierDesc: Deliberately damaged/erased. Implies conflict or cover-up; clue points to *who* did it.
setup.restDesc: Your barricades, lookout, or hidden spot held perfectly. You wake feeling refreshed and safe.
setup.catalyst: The master of the city guard declares martial law without authorization (arrests and executions begin without trial)
setup.distortionHow: People think the consequence caused the catalyst. The symptom is treated as the disease.
setup.distortionPrompt: *What do locals think caused this? How does following their logic lead to a dead end or a different problem?*

skin.text: The pigeons in the square have started forming shapes. — Not roosting at random but arranging themselves, briefly, into patterns before scattering — gone before anyone can say what they saw.

segments.label: Cold Scene
segments.description: Rented chamber in an inn or warehouse stripped of belongings overnight; innkeeper details departure
segments.transition: 1: Bribed innkeeper recalls direction 2: Neighbor saw who took items 3: Room recently re-rented with new occupant 4: Forwarding message left in wall

encounter.text: Lucky Find: A dropped pouch, forgotten stash, or unlooted cache turns up in the party's path. (benefit: Gain 3d6 gp and one common consumable (potion of healing, antitoxin, or oil of slipperiness).)

dressing.text: Wall vent with lint and insect husks.

valuable.name: A tuning fork that strikes a moment of perfect silence
valuable.note: Every sound within ten paces stops for one full breath. Twice a day — after the second, it's just a fork until sundown.

segments.label: Cold Scene
segments.description: Watering hole where the target's bar bill remains unsettled; bartender remembers their final drink and mood
segments.transition: 1: Bartender knows the payer 2: Other regular knows target's business 3: Unpaid debt means blackmail 4: Target left message with barkeep

encounter.text: Cult/Kidnapping: Press Gang Trapdoor: A tavern floorboard flips open. DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure: The PC drops into the basement where 1d4+1 Thugs are waiting with clubs to beat them unconscious and sell them to a pirate ship.

sceneFrame.tactical: Dense cluster of 12 small 5' x 5' stalls; narrow 5' passages.

dressing.text: Chain divider hanging like a curtain.

backgroundEvent.text: Courtyard Dance: Someone practices formal dance steps in a small yard while a stern relative counts beats from a chair.

valuable.name: A carved soapstone figurine of a hound
valuable.note: Simple, worn smooth by a thumb that rubbed it for luck.

segments.label: Hot Scene
segments.description: Target at a card table or dice game, deep in a tavern's locked back room surrounded by armed security
segments.transition: 1: Demand entry as authorized player 2: Knock out the guards from outside 3: Negotiate for target's release 4: Target vanishes through secret exit

encounter.text: A moneylender is calling in debts simultaneously across the district (merchants realize they've all borrowed from him; he owns them)

dressing.text: Splintered shield pieces embedded in wood.

atmo.text: a dog barking once or twice

magic.name: Moon-touched Sword
magic.desc: This sword sheds dim moonlight (15 ft) in darkness. No other magical property.

valuable.name: A carved idol whose small smile has changed since you picked it up
valuable.note: It hasn't moved. You'd swear it hasn't moved.

finale.revelation: A faction has been subtly steering the party's investigation — not controlling it, but influencing which clues come to light and which stay buried.
finale.exitState: Trust shatters like glass — neighbors eye each other with suspicion. The authority that was supposed to protect them failed. Informal networks form. People lock their doors. The community fractures.

valuable.name: A small painted miniature portrait, subject unknown

rolled.setting: Coalstack Row: A terraced mining town where the houses climb the valley side in stairstep rows and every face is smudged black by noon.
rolled.trait: The town is built on a slope steep enough that streets run in terraced tiers; upper districts are wealthy, lower districts are not, and the retaining walls between them are everyone's shared problem.
rolled.calamity: A retaining wall in the mid-district showed movement last week; the engineering survey says it needs immediate repair; the upper district owners who benefit most are refusing to pay the proportional share.
rolled.secret: One wealthy house was let off the wall-levy "just this once" during the rebuild; every house has refused to pay it since, the wall has gone thirty years unrepaired, and the breach on the north side is widening.

segments.label: Entry

type.name: Concealed Panel
type.desc: No visible door. A section of wall depresses, slides, or rotates on a hidden mechanism; DC to detect and locate trigger.

state.name: Locked — No Key
state.desc: Designed to stay shut. Requires picking, forcing, or an alternate route. No key was ever meant to exist here.

segments.side: 10' x 40' elevated rope bridge crossing the upper cavern from ledge to ledge, 20 ft above the floor.
segments.scene: The doorway behind you appears narrower than when you entered.
segments.lightFlavor: Motes glitter in the beam like tiny embers.
segments.sensory: The temperature drops sharply two steps inside the threshold and never quite recovers.

feature.flavor: A hidden lever sits beside the assembly.
feature.dims: 5'×3' assembly + 1' lever recess — No cover; lever activates the mechanism

dressing.text: Finger-drawn spiral in dust, recently refreshed.

secret.desc: Concealed utility room. Store, guard nook, ritual prep room, office—contains info + something practical.

texture.name: A small wooden statuette of a smug halfling.

state.name: Locked — No Key

feature.name: Web Canopy
feature.flavor: Thick webbing fills the upper half of the room.
feature.dims: 20'×20' coverage, 5'–15' off floor — Large+ creatures entering upper space are Restrained

dressing.text: A vent hole stuffed with rags (someone tried to block airflow).

secret.desc: Major secret chamber tied to dungeon origin. Founding mark, ward node, relic niche, iconic mural/inscription.

segments.lightFlavor: Washed-out near colorless; symbols pop hard.

object.name: Valve wheel
object.flavor: Seized, then gives with a shriek.

feature.name: Support Pillars
feature.flavor: Hairline fractures spider along the stone.
feature.dims: 5'×5' base, 15' high — Total cover; Thunder damage causes partial collapse (2d6 Bludgeoning)

dressing.text: Bedroll and blanket, neatly rolled, too neat.

secret.desc: Loose stone / floorboard stash. Trifle + clue fragment (scrap, token, wax seal, chalk mark).

device.name: Social Leverage
device.situation: Controls or withholds something the party needs — or the reverse; the party holds something they need
device.misread: Players assume combat is the only language here

state.desc: Applies to portcullises, stone slabs, and any door with a mechanical component. Roll 1d2: 1 = stuck open, 2 = stuck closed.

segments.side: 10' x 10' secure vault recessed into the floor; iron hatch, triple-locked.
segments.scene: The room is warmer than it should be. Not unpleasantly — as if something once lived here and the warmth never left.
segments.lightFlavor: Warm light pools in “islands” between dark gaps.
segments.sensory: The room smells of paper and cold iron, and the silence has the brittle edge of a sealed archive.

object.name: Cistern lid
object.flavor: Heavy stone lid with finger grooves.

feature.name: Web Canopy

dressing.text: Braziers with old ash and bone-white charcoal.

secret.desc: Major route revelation. Shortcut to approach/finale region, escape tunnel, hidden stair to another depth (optional).
secret.skills: Investigation / Perception / Thieves’ Tools / Sleight of Hand

finale.finaleDesc: A foreign landscape replaces the chamber.
finale.bossBehavior: Already wounded from a prior conflict. Start them bloodied or with one condition already present.

device.name: The Archivist
device.situation: Has been observing and recording events in this dungeon, possibly for a long time; knows things about the party they shouldn't
device.misread: Players see a threat — how do they know that?
device.leverage: Their records are the prize; whoever they report to is either a resource or a danger depending on who the party is

finale.revelation: The dungeon is a diplomatic offering between planes.
finale.exitState: The path leading back seems less clear.
